title: Microsoft Outlook SPF Validation Error (550 5.7.23): Why Emails Bounce and How to Fix It
content_md: A Microsoft Outlook SPF validation error can turn a routine email into a bounce: “550 5.7.23 The message was rejected because of Sender Policy Framework violation”. If Outlook.com is rejecting emails, or you are seeing emails to Hotmail bouncing back, start with the complete rejection report—not a frantic change to your DNS. Article Link: Outlook SPF Validation Error 550 5.7.23: How to Fix It
exclude_reason: Generic Outlook SPF bounce troubleshooting how-to, not a security event.
